laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.

laptops.raw_markdown: Whether it's a dorm desk, coffee shop table, or home office, space is, and always has been, a luxury. The same way high performance PC gaming has been a luxury, and historically, you've had to choose between the two. However, with the new OMEN 16 Slim, a thinner reimagining of our flagship OMEN 16, you no longer have to choose. With up to an NVIDIA® RTX™ 50 Series GPU, Intel® Core™ Ultra 200H Processor, and plenty of upgradeable DDR5 RAM, it's the same great performance, only more space-proof.
